name: Remap
summary: Applies coordinate mapping (cv::remap) to rectify epipolar lines or correct distortion. Optional maps input overrides Map X and may contain both map_x/map_y.

map_x.label: Map X file (or preset: identity, flip_h, flip_v, flip_hv)
map_x.description: Path to XML/YAML/EXR file containing map_x (and map_y), or a preset name like identity, flip_h, flip_v, flip_hv.

map_y.label: Map Y file (optional if embedded in Map X)
map_y.description: Path to separate Map Y file if not embedded in Map X.

borderMode.label: Border Mode
borderMode.description: Extrapolation method for pixels outside boundaries.
